A school or class for children beginning their education
My daughter painted a bright yellow bird at kindergarten.
我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的小鸟。

优质的学前教育能培养儿童的社交能力，为更系统的学习做好准备。

A distinct period in a process of change or development.
One of the changing shapes of the moon as seen.
To introduce or remove something gradually in planned stages.
The kitchen repairs have entered their final phase.
厨房维修已进入最后阶段。

a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment
a person or company that runs a business or service
a person who connects calls or provides telephone assistance

每家公共交通运营商都应确保行动不便的乘客能够使用其服务。

Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise

We marvelled at the tiny bird's beautifully woven nest.
那只小鸟精巧编织的巢让我们惊叹不已。
The new bridge is an engineering marvel that connects isolated communities and improves access to essential services.
这座新桥是一项工程奇迹，连接了偏远社区，并让居民更方便地获得基本服务。
a marvel of nature｜自然奇观
动词常接at；英式过去式marvelled，美式marveled。
to use rude or offensive words
to make a serious promise or insist something is true
Please don't swear when the game goes wrong.
玩游戏不顺利时，请不要说脏话。

在许多法律体系中，证人作证前必须宣誓如实陈述。

过去式swore，过去分词sworn；swear at指咒骂。

导游向我们简要介绍了游览安排。

Our cafe handles recruitment before the busy summer season.
我们咖啡馆会在繁忙的夏季到来之前招聘员工。

公平的招聘方式有助于雇主吸引来自不同社会背景的优秀求职者。
通常不可数；招聘某类人员用recruitment of。
Not very serious, important, or large.
A person younger than the legal age of adulthood.
Using a musical scale often associated with a sad sound.
The bike only needs a few minor repairs.
这辆自行车只需要稍作修理。
Minor changes to daily travel habits can collectively reduce pollution in densely populated urban areas.
日常出行习惯的小改变，累积起来可以减少人口密集城区的污染。
minor injury指轻伤；名词a minor指未成年人。
To examine facts carefully to discover what happened or why.
To study a subject carefully to learn more about it.
A plumber came to investigate the strange noise upstairs.
一位水管工来查明楼上怪声的原因。
Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces affects the mental health of urban residents.
研究人员正在探究接触绿地如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

To make something clear through examples or evidence.
To provide pictures for a book or other publication.
She used two jars to illustrate the difference.
她用两个罐子来说明其中的区别。

这些研究结果说明，公共交通的可及性如何改善弱势社区的就业机会。

illustrate the importance of｜说明……的重要性
illustrate可用例子说明，不一定涉及图片。
Deserving great admiration or bringing honour and pride.
We spent a glorious afternoon swimming in the lake.
我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个美好的下午。
Museums should examine difficult historical events as carefully as they celebrate a nation's glorious achievements.
博物馆应像颂扬一个国家的辉煌成就一样，认真审视艰难的历史事件。
glorious既可指值得荣耀，也可赞美天气或景色。
A list of things to check or do
I use a checklist when packing for a trip.
旅行收拾行李时，我会用一份核对清单。

可数名词；强调逐项核对，不只是罗列物品。
easy to understand or do, without complications
honest and direct in expressing thoughts or intentions

这道食谱很简单，即使初学者也能照着做。

政府应简化回收流程，让更多家庭能够参与，避免不必要的困惑。
a straightforward answer｜直截了当的回答

To rub skin with fingernails, often to relieve itching.
To damage a surface with something sharp or rough.
A thin mark or shallow injury caused by something sharp.

别挠那个被叮的包，会越挠越严重。

即使是可重复使用容器上的一道小划痕，也可能让它更难被彻底清洁。

a glass or plastic building that keeps growing plants warm
We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse throughout the winter.
整个冬天，我们都在温室里种番茄。

温室种植可以延长生长季，但为这些设施供暖可能需要消耗大量能源。
grow plants in a greenhouse｜在温室里种植物
greenhouse gas emissions｜温室气体排放
greenhouse是名词，也可作定语，如greenhouse gases。
The ability to achieve results without wasting time, energy, or resources

把工具整理好提高了我的工作效率。

有凝聚力的；紧密结合的

The outer covering of a seed or fruit.

招股说明书；项目介绍书

我查看了学院的招生简章，寻找摄影课程。

大学招生简章应准确介绍学费、课程内容及可获得的学生支持服务。
request a prospectus｜索取招生简章
issue a prospectus｜发布招股说明书

A fourteen-line poem following a particular rhyme and rhythm pattern.
She read a sonnet aloud beside the open window.

An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests

领事可以为在海外遇到困难的本国公民提供支持，并帮助加强国家间的商业联系。

Moving or adjusting something carefully, often using hands or tools.

Two concurrent meetings meant I had to choose one.
两个会议同时举行，我只能选择参加其中一个。

同步改善住房和公共交通，可以使城市发展更具包容性和可持续性。

Make someone feel pleased or honoured through attention or praise.

在这样的光线下，那件蓝色夹克真的很衬你。

广告常常暗示选择某种产品代表聪明或品位好，以此讨好消费者。

请别干涉我如何布置自己的房间。

the act of considering a possible future action

the bottom edge of a doorway
the point just before a new experience or period begins

提高经济援助的收入门槛，将使更多低薪劳动者能够获得支持。

on the threshold of表示即将进入某个新阶段。
To be the parts that form a whole
To be considered a particular thing
To formally establish an organisation or governing body
Vegetables constitute most of the food in our fridge.
我们冰箱里的食物大部分是蔬菜。

不断上涨的住房成本构成了大城市年轻人实现经济独立的一大障碍。

护士向我解释了明天手术前要做的检查。

An area beside a sea, lake, or river, especially in towns.

我们早早吃完晚饭后沿着水岸散步。

滨水区改造可以创造宜人的公共空间，前提是不迫使原有居民搬离。

Not genuine, or intended to deceive people

我们一走，他那虚假的笑容就消失了。

Quick to notice or understand things.

经济适用住房的严重短缺迫使许多年轻劳动者住在远离工作地点的地方。
To allow fresh air to enter and circulate through somewhere.

做完饭后打开两扇窗，给厨房通风。

学校应定期给教室通风，以改善室内空气质量，创造更健康的学习环境。
